content.hebrew: אֲבִי הַתְּעוּדָה לָבַשׁ עֲנָוָה כְמַדָּיו,
content.transliteration: ‘avi hatte‘uda lavash ‘anava khemaddav,
content.english: The father of the teaching wore humility as his attire,
content.comments: The father of the teaching. Moses.

content.hebrew: נָאַם בְּיוֹם בֹּאוֹ לְפַרְעֹה. הִרְבָּה שִׂכָּיו וְצִדָּיו,
content.transliteration: Na’am beyom bo’o lefar’o. Hirba sikkav vetsiddav,
content.english: He spoke on the day that he came to Pharaoh. [But] he increased his thorns and his constraints,

content.hebrew: לְהָרַע לְעַמְּךָ, וַתֶּאֱרַֽכְנָה פֹארֹתָיו וּבַדָּיו,
content.transliteration: Lehara‘ le‘ammekha – vatte’erakhna forotav uvaddav –
content.english: In order to harm Your people. His boughs and branches extended far,

content.hebrew: קהל: גַּאֲוָתוֹ וּגְאוֹנוֹ וְעֶבְרָתוֹ, לֹא כֵן בַּדָּיו.   (ישעיהו טז:ו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ga’avato uḡ’ono ve‘evrato, lo khen baddav.
content.english: Cong. His pride, his haughtiness, and his wrath. But his children would not have this opportunity.  (Isa. 16:6)

content.hebrew: הָאֵל אָמַר, וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה? וְדִבֶּר, וְלֹא יְקִימֶֽנָּה?
content.transliteration: Ha’el amar, velo ya‘asē? Vedibber, velo yeḳimenna?
content.english: God has uttered, so will He not act? He has spoken, so will He not follow through?

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂה לּוֹ, עֵינֶֽיךָ תִּרְאֶֽינָה.
content.transliteration: Asher e‘esē lo, ‘enekha tirena.
content.english: “What I will do to him, your eyes will see.

content.hebrew: כִּי מַכּוֹתַי אַחַת אֶל אַחַת לוֹ אֶֽעֶרְכֶנָּה,
content.transliteration: Ki makkotai aḥat el aḥat lo e‘erkhenna,
content.english: For I will line up my plagues against him, one by one,

content.hebrew: קהל: אַף דִּבַּֽרְתִּי אַף אֲבִיאֶֽנָּה, יָצַֽרְתִּי אַף אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה.  (ישעיהו מו:יא)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Af dibbarti af avi’enna, yatsarti af e‘esenna,
content.english: Cong. I have spoken, and indeed I will bring it about; I have fashioned, and indeed I will make it.   (Isa. 46:11)

content.hebrew: רוּחִי בְּאָבוֹת שְׁלֹשָׁה, בְּאֵל שַׁדַּי, תִּשְׁמַֽעְנָה אָזְנֶֽיךָ,
content.transliteration: Ruḥi be’avot shelosha, be’El Shadday, tishma‘na oznekha,
content.english: “My spirit was on the three Patriarchs, with [the name] El Shaddai, which your ears hear,

content.hebrew: וּלְךָ, הַגֹּאֵל, נִגְלֵֽיתִי בְּאִסְפַּקְלַרְיָא הַמְאִירָה, רָאוּ עֵינֶֽיךָ.
content.transliteration: Ulkha, haggo’el, niḡleti be‘ispaḳlarya ham’ira, ra’u ‘enekha.
content.english: But to you, the redeemer, have I revealed Myself through a clear looking-glass, which your eyes see.

content.hebrew: הֶעֱבַֽרְתִּי כָּל־טוּבִי עַל פָּנֶֽיךָ,
content.transliteration: He‘evarti kol tuvi ‘al panekha,
content.english: I have caused all My goodness to pass before your face,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְקָרָֽאתִי בְשֵׁם יוי לְפָנֶֽיךָ.     (שמות לג:יט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Veḳarati veshem Adonai lefanekha.
content.english: Cong. And I call the name Adonai in front of you. (Exod. 33:19)

content.hebrew: נַאֲקַת עַמִּי בָּֽאָה לְפָנָי, וְאֵיךְ עַֽיִן אַעְלִים?
content.transliteration: Na’aḳat ‘ammi ba’a lefanay, ve’ekh ‘ayin a‘lim?
content.english: “My people’s outcry has come before Me, so how can I avert My eye?

content.hebrew: וְהוֹצֵאתִים וְהִצַּלְתִּים מִיַּד עֹֽבְדֵי גִלּוּלִים,
content.transliteration: Vehotsetim vehits’tsaltim miyyad ‘ovedē ḡillulim,
content.english: I will take them out, and rescue them from the hands of the idol worshippers;

content.hebrew: וְגָאַלְתִּֽי אֹתָם, וְהָלְכוּ גְאוּלִים,
content.transliteration: Veḡalti otam, vehalekhu ge’ulim,
content.english: I will redeem them, and they will go redeemed,

content.hebrew: קהל: בִּזְרֽוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבִשְׁפָטִים גְּדֹלִים.    (שמות ו:ו)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Bizro’a‘ netuya uvishfatim gedolim.
content.english: Cong. With an outstretched arm and great judgments. (Exod. 6:6)

content.hebrew: לָקַֽחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם לִי לְעָם; וּלְכָךְ הִרְבֵּיתִי חֶזְיוֹנָי,
content.transliteration: Laḳaḥti etkhem li le‘am; ulkhakh hirbeti ḥezyonay,
content.english: “I am taking you as a people for Me; therefore I have provided much prophecy,

content.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים, בְּדָת הֶגְיוֹנָי,
content.transliteration: Lihyot lakhem lelohim, bedat heḡyonay,
content.english: To be God for you, according to My Law, My teachings.

content.hebrew: וּלְהָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל אֶֽרֶץ כְּנַֽעַן עָלָה בְרַעְיוֹנָי,
content.transliteration: Ulhavi etkhem el erets Kena‘an ‘ala vera‘yonay,
content.english: And it is in my thoughts to bring you to the Land of Canaan,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְנָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ לָכֶם מוֹרָשָׁה, אֲנִי יוי.   (שמות ו:ח)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Venattati otah lakhem morasha, ani Adonai.
content.english: Cong. And I will give it to you as an inheritance—I am Adonai.” (Exod. 6:8)

content.hebrew: עוּרִֽי עוּרִֽי זְרֽוֹעַ יוי, לְעַם עַתָּה רַב נְדוּדוֹ,
content.transliteration: ‘uri uri zero’a‘ Adonai, le‘am ‘atta rav nedudo,
content.english: Awake, awake, arm of Adonai, for the nation that has wandered overmuch.
content.comments: Awake. Here the poet’s own voice resumes after the conclusion of God’s speech to Moses.

content.hebrew: עֽוּרִי כִּימֵי קֶֽדֶם, יִלְבַּשׁ הֲדָרוֹ וְהוֹדוֹ:
content.transliteration: ‘uri kimē ḳedem, yilbash hadaro vehodo:
content.english: Awake, as in days of old; may they wear their beauty and splendor:

content.hebrew: מֶֽלֶךְ בַּעֲטָרָה, וְכֹהֵן בְּאוּרִים וְתֻמִּים בְּאֵפוֹדוֹ.
content.transliteration: Melekh ba‘atara, vekhohen be’urim vetummim be’efodo.
content.english: The king with a crown, and the priest with the Urim and Tummim in his ephod.

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי בָנָה יוי צִיּוֹן, נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ.   (תהלים קב:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon, nir’ah bikhvodo:
content.english: Cong. For Adonai has built Zion; He is seen in His Glory.  (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ: (תהלים קב:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon nir’ah bikhvodo:
content.english: Cantor. For Adonai has built Zion; He is seen in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is the Glory of Adonai from His place.  (Ezek. 3:12)
